messages:
meera: Heads-up: proposal to run a 'sticker-station walk' + handwritten postcard drop for spot-award folks next Thurs. aim: super casual, 3-4 min stops, no ceremony. who wants to run routes?
dan: I can do north wing. prefer 11am so folks are at desks. need list + desk numbers.
lisa: happy to coordinate print + postcard assembly. can we keep postcards pre-printed with a blank line for a personal note?
meera: yep pre-printed template works. keep message 1 line + sign. ops-bot: Reminder: payroll reporting for spot awards due in 5 business days. submit amounts to payroll portal to avoid delays.
sam: I'll own HQ logistics (station table, stickers, extra pens). also ok to collect quick photo if consent given.
dan: route volunteers: dan north, sam central, meera south. lisa handles assembly + remote ship.
lisa: inventory check: need 40 postcards, 40 stickers, 25 enamel pins. can fund up to $120 for printing.
meera: budget approved. lisa pls order prints by Tue EOD.
ops-bot: Note: awards >$100 taxable. flag exceptions in the payroll sheet.
sam: quick checklist for station leads:
```
- confirm recipient present at desk
- give postcard + sticker (and pin if opted)
- snap 1 photo only if consent Y
- note "collected" in sheet + timestamp
```
dan: can remote folks get postcards shipped? lisa: yes will pack and ship Wed. need addresses by Tue noon.
meera: adding a column 'photo_consent' and 'ship_or_pickup' in the sheet. link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1StickerStation-Run (fill cols F/G).
lisa: shipping plan: domestic via USPS, small international via courier partner. will add tracking to sheet.
sam: can we add a "quiet please" tag for teams who prefer no photos/fanfare?
meera: good idea. add a "no_photo_no_fanfare" checkbox.
ops-bot: Payroll cutoff reminder: exports must be ready Mon 9am PT for next payroll cycle.
meera: final actions: 1) meera finalize recipients Mon morning, 2) lisa order prints Tue, 3) sam gather station supplies Wed, 4) dan/sam/meera run Thurs 11am.
dan: confirmed. i'll DM folks who are out-of-desk during slot.
lisa: will post packing checklist and courier matrix once addresses are in.
sam: keeping it small & human. thanks team :)
